facts.fact: Minister of State for Elderly Affairs Dominic Mafwabi Gidudu said SAGE gives senior citizens a monthly cash transfer, and that its payments require bank accounts linked to National Identification Numbers.
Gidudu said SAGE and SEGOP payments require bank accounts linked to National Identification Numbers, so older persons without a national ID will struggle to access them.

systems.platform: monthly cash transfer paid into bank accounts
systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development

note: Only one programme is shown paid digitally; SEGOP is an enterprise grant with no payment channel stated.
